facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 74°F at pass elevation.

facts.text: Snow left North Fork (3,070 ft) and Blazed Alder (3,660 ft) 27 to 38 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: North Fork
evidence.detail: left April 19; earlier seasons: June 7 (2023), May 16 (2024), April 26 (2025)

evidence.name: Blazed Alder
evidence.detail: left April 20; earlier seasons: June 2 (2023), May 28 (2024), May 7 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at North Fork (3,070 ft) and Blazed Alder (3,660 ft).

evidence.name: North Fork
evidence.detail: 2.3 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 45.5 in (2023), 20.0 in (2024), 11.3 in (2025)

evidence.name: Blazed Alder
evidence.detail: 7.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 49.0 in (2023), 28.3 in (2024), 22.9 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between January 25 and April 16, carried from the melt-out date at North Fork (3,070 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: North Fork
evidence.detail: melted out April 19, 2,496 ft above the pass; points to January 25 to April 16
